usedFor: Speechnotes turns audio into text, and HubSpot receives it as deals and updates through “Create Deal” and “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Transcription Complete” in Speechnotes, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A finished transcript can open a deal in HubSpot without retyping it.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in HubSpot needs the deal ID, and “Update Contact” needs the contact's email.
